ResearcherNotesUnit: Announced 1 Feb 2026 by Türkiye's energy minister: a second FSRU at the existing BOTAŞ Dörtyol terminal (Hatay) to double daily regas capacity from ~28 to ~56 Mcm/d. Press cites ~7.5 mtpa for the new phase ('equivalent to the first FSRU Ertuğrul Gazi'); engineering studies underway, BOTAŞ to oversee integration. No completion date or new vessel named yet. Capacity figure single-tier (yellow) — verify and reconcile vs the existing Dörtyol unit's GEM figure of 5.7 mtpa.
